en: The Section on Detailed Exposition, Chapter Thirteen: Convergence (Sampāta)
The Convergence of the Modes of Purification.
Therein, what is the convergence of the modes of purification?
It is the verse beginning: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range of right intention...”
Where the undertaking is pure, that question is answered;
but where the undertaking is not pure, that question is not yet answered.
The section on the Modes of Conveying the Purification is concluded.
